caption: The drawing depicts three male figures marching from left to right, each dressed in similar blue uniforms with long coats, dark blue trousers, and blue hats with visors. The first figure on the left is playing a red and brown drum with yellow details and carries two drumsticks; he has a visible black strap running from his shoulder to the drum. The second figure in the center is playing a brass trumpet or bugle, with his cheeks puffed out, and also has a black strap running diagonally across his chest. The third figure on the right is holding two large golden-brown cymbals, one in each hand, and appears to be in the act of clashing them together. Each figure’s uniform is decorated with gold details, and all three have black shoes. There is no background; the figures are drawn against a plain off-white surface. The artist’s signature, “George S. Fila,” is written in small text below the rightmost figure.
title: Civil War Soldiers
